title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E01 — NASA Nazi Conspiracy
A team of experts investigates if there was a conspiracy to fake the moon landing, and uncovers a secret report on hundreds of Nazis involved in the Apollo space program.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E05 — CIA's Secret Space War
Confidential CIA files reveal a top-secret war for space between the US and the Soviets, and a team of experts investigates if new discoveries about American espionage during the Apollo program provide evidence of a conspiracy.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E03 — Killing Armstrong
Apollo 11's lunar module nearly killed Neil Armstrong during training, and some believe this close-call could explain a conspiracy to fake the moon landing; investigating if dangers that the Apollo 11 crew faced were motive for a cover-up.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E04 — Conspiracy of the Lost Tapes
The NASA tapes that recorded the Apollo 11 moon landing are missing, and some believe their disappearance is part of a cover-up to hide the truth; experts use cutting-edge tech to hunt for this lost evidence and shed light on a possible conspiracy.

title: Truth Behind the Moon Landing
description:
S01 E06 — The Hollywood Conspiracy
Some believe that the moon's waving American flag is the smoking gun that NASA faked the moon landing, and as a team of experts investigates this strange piece of evidence, the trail leads all the way to some of Hollywood's biggest names.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E05 — Curse of the Armada Graveyard
A cutting edge investigation into a deep-sea graveyard of 25 shipwrecks reveals the dark secrets of the biggest naval battle in history, and using the latest tech, experts follow new evidence into the mysterious abyss of long-lost battleships.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E01 — Bermuda Triangle: Hunt for the Cotopaxi
The disappearance of the SS Cotopaxi helped launch the legend of the Bermuda Triangle; a team of experts follows fresh leads with cutting-edge tech to investigate if a mysterious wreck off the coast of Florida is indeed the long-lost ship.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E02 — Ghost Fleet of Doom
New discoveries reveal the treasures of a ghost fleet of Japanese ships at the bottom of the South Pacific, and using cutting-edge underwater technology, experts investigate a top-secret superweapon that could have changed the course of World War II.

title: Shipwreck Secrets
description:
S01 E03 — Haunting at Lake Erie
A mysterious shipwreck at the bottom of Lake Erie could be the oldest wreck in America's most notorious ship graveyard, and using cutting-edge underwater archaeological methods, experts investigate new leads in this 200-year-old cold case.

description:
S06 E01 — Saturn's Moon Monsters
When NASA discovers something strange on Saturn's biggest moon, experts investigate if aliens feeding on the world's electric atmosphere could be the culprit; the disturbing evidence points to an apocalypse if these monsters ever make it to Earth.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S06 E06 — Secrets of the Alien Signals
When NASA begins a strange experiment to communicate with dolphins, experts investigate if it's a prelude to making alien contact; some fear that such a discovery could have apocalyptic consequences.

title: NASA's Unexplained Files
description:
S04 E02 — Rise of the Planet Killer
A Mars mission captures an image of a strange structure on the planet; an intriguing sight on the dark side of the moon; a planet-eating star gives scientists a peek of Earth's bleak future.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E01 — Are Black Holes Real?
Cosmologists say there are black holes throughout the Universe, but they've never seen one, and it's almost impossible to study them directly.

title: How the Universe Works
description:
S06 E07 — The Quasar Engima
Quasars are the brightest and most powerful objects in the universe, and though they have shaped the cosmos, they might ultimately destroy everything that exists.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E01 — Future Robotic Warfare
Former CIA operative Mike Baker investigates top-secret government programs steeped in cutting-edge science; Mike speaks with experts, government officials and scientists to go deeper into the black files than ever before.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E02 — Secrets of the Paranormal
Uncovered documents reveal a black file containing studies of werewolves, sprites and floating orbs; Mike Baker investigates how the U.S. government may have funded a classified program directly focused on the research of paranormal phenomena.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E03 — Secret World of Mind Control
Many U.S. government personnel have reported sustaining unexplained and debilitating neurological injuries while working abroad; Mike Baker investigates if these invisible, mind-altering attacks are evidence of active mind-control programs worldwide.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E04 — The Black Manta
Unidentified black triangles have been reported in flight over top-secret military bases for decades, and now, Mike Baker investigates if the US government is involved in developing experimental aircraft, or if this could be something otherworldly.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E05 — Presidential Power Secrets
Presidential Emergency Action Documents have the potential to grant the U.S. president unlimited authority; Mike Baker investigates how these files are among the most secretive documents in U.S. government and what might trigger their use.

title: Black Files Declassified
description:
S02 E07 — Mystery of Mission 7
In 2013, the USS Jimmy Carter deployed on a classified mission that received a presidential citation of heroism.

description:

A Russian medical assistant films a horrifying procedure as a live, four-foot-long snake is extracted from a patient's mouth; experts investigate a potential resurgence in ancient, pre-Christian religions involving complex and dangerous rituals.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:
S01 E03 — Sutro Tower
Trask and his crew scale Sutro Tower to inspect crucial cable junctions and must avoid deadly radiation at nearly 1,000 feet in the air; in Oregon, loose boulders need to be removed along a cliffside road that needs to be reopened.

title: Engineering on the Edge
description:

Trask and his team take on the iconic Space Needle in Seattle to fix an aging window-washing basket; in San Antonio, they look to get a stadium ready for game day.

The remnants of a settlement in Nevada are interspersed with disintegrating machinery; experts uncover an abandoned mine where dreams of discovering a fortune were met with chaos and murder.

description:
S07 E02 — American Ghost Park
Deep in the wilderness of the American South, a long-abandoned amusement park is home to secrets of a forgotten, imaginary world; experts reveal why this bizarre place was built and what caused its downfall.

title: Mysteries of the Abandoned
description:
S07 E11 — Ghosts of the Cursed Castle
The ruins of a historic Scottish castle is now a bewitching wilderness of hidden dangers with deadly booby traps obscured afoot; experts and historians reveal a bygone Second World War military hospital with bizarre ties to an infamous Nazi occupant.

S07 E01 — Into the Murder Labyrinth
An underground labyrinth once used by a secret police force could warp the mind and turn friend into foe; experts turn up new evidence pointing to madness, murder and mayhem, revealing what happened in these cursed tunnels and why it was abandoned.

A deserted facility in the remote countryside features mysterious graffiti that may be highly advanced mathematical equations pointing to a dark secret; experts investigate this classified military wasteland with a deadly past.

description:

Abandoned hangers and bunkers populate a bizarre facility in the middle of nowhere, but among them are other structures whose purpose are oddly obscured; experts investigate a highly-classified military cover-up with extraterrestrial objectives.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E05 — Skyscraper Collapses
Pinpoint the mistakes that cause major structural failures; explore the preventable explosion inside London's Ronan Point; the code violations that collapsed Lalita Park; the short circuit that set off a deadly fire in Tehran's Plasco Building.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E02 — Bridge Collapses
Bridge collapses have etched hard lessons into the history of engineering; Tacoma, Minneapolis, Genoa, symbols of innovation that have become stark reminders of what happens when flaws go unchecked.

title: Fatal Engineering
description:
S01 E06 — Nuclear Plant Disasters
Hunt for the root cause of atomic accidents; examine the Windscale fire, which led to safer reactor designs; learn why swift crisis management helped in the Three Mile Island incident; see why improper waste disposal fuelled the Kyshtym disaster.
